_comment: ign-lint rules for the lab's Perspective views, the same in every lab from Lab 03 on. Component min_length is 1: the station tiles use two-letter names (CO, HT, ...) and the dense KPI/status tiles use single-character leaf names (L, V, U, S) by design. Scripts are linted with .config/.ignition-pylintrc: ign-lint's bundled pylint config plus import-outside-toplevel disabled, because a Perspective transform or event script is a function body and can only import inside itself. ign-lint resolves that path against its working directory, so it (and debug_dir, the scratch folder for pylint's input) is repo-root-relative and every ign-lint run (CI, the pre-commit hook, by hand) starts in the repo root. Docs: https://bw-design-group.github.io/ignition-lint
